## LLM010 Hardcoded API key

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Level | error |
| Framework | Both |
| Autofix | no patch; fix it by hand as described below |
| More | https://pgy763.github.io/llm-dev-pitfalls/auth/密钥提交进了git历史 |
| Turn it off | `LLM010: off` in .llm-lint.yml, or `--disable LLM010` on the command line |

Once a key is committed to git it stays in the history forever. Deleting the line is not enough — clones and forks still carry it; revoke it first, then rotate.

To mute it in one place, put `// llm-lint:ignore LLM010` on that line or the line above.
<!-- /generated:llm010 -->

## What it looks like

An `sk-...` / `AIza...` / `AKIA...` literal in Java source or a test.

## How to fix

Move it to an environment variable or a secret manager, rotate the key, and rewrite the git history if it was pushed.
